text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

The channel has no other guard updates. The only later guard detail is from Mateo at 11:03 AM, when kiosk 1 came back and "guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it."
